title: Dang Qiu and Anders Lind miss WTT Star Contender Muscat as Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic lead the seeds
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat draw: Dang Qiu and Lind out
description: Dang Qiu and Anders Lind are not in the WTT Star Contender Muscat main draw. Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic are top seeds; the last 64 starts on Wednesday.
standfirst: Two of the men named in the field at the weekend are missing as the main draw starts on Wednesday, with the top 16 seeds in each singles draw waiting in the last 32.
body: Germany's Dang Qiu and Denmark's Anders Lind are not in the men's singles draw at WTT Star Contender Muscat, which was published on Tuesday evening, leaving Slovenia's Darko Jorgic as top seed. Japan's Satsuki Odo is the top seed in the women's singles.

Dang, the world No 16, and Lind, the world No 18, were both listed among the leading men in the main-draw field before qualifying began on Monday. No reason has been given for either absence. For Lind it is a second event in a row: he was top seed at WTT Contender Istanbul last week but did not play his opening singles or doubles matches there. The men's draw has no third seed.

Liang Jingkun, reported by Chinese media to have pulled out of a second straight WTT event, is not in the draw either. He withdrew from Istanbul with no reason given and was left out of China's squad for the Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu, which starts on 29 November.

The singles draws have 48 players each. The 16 highest seeds have byes into the last 32, so Wednesday's play at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex is the 16 matches of the last 64 in each draw, plus the first round of all three doubles events. Play starts at 7am UK time (11am in Muscat).
## The seeds

Jorgic, the world No 14, heads a men's draw in which Japan's Shunsuke Togami is second seed, Russia's Vladimir Sidorenko fourth and South Korea's Oh Junsung fifth. Hiroto Shinozuka, Dimitrij Ovtcharov and France's 18-year-old Flavien Coton complete the top eight. China's Li Tianyang, the world No 41, also has a bye, in the third quarter.

Odo, the world No 10, is seeded to meet Honoka Hashimoto in the final. Hashimoto won [WTT Contender Istanbul on Sunday](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html) and is second seed. South Korea's Joo Cheonhui, last year's runner-up in Muscat, is third, with Miyu Nagasaki fourth, Romania's Bernadette Szőcs fifth, Sakura Yokoi sixth, China's Qin Yuxuan seventh and Russia's Elizabet Abraamian eighth. Taiwan's Cheng I-Ching, seeded 10th, is in Hashimoto's quarter.
## Wednesday's matches to watch
**Sofia Polcanova v Maria Xiao (4.30pm UK)**: Austria's world No 50 plays Spain's world No 59 in the last match of the day. The winner meets Cheng.

**Manika Batra v Wei Jingming (2.10pm UK)**: India's world No 63 against a 17-year-old Chinese player ranked 222nd. Batra also plays women's doubles with Swastika Ghosh against Polcanova and Australia's Yangzi Liu in the morning.

**Marcos Freitas v Huang Youzheng (4.30pm UK)**: Portugal's 38-year-old, ranked 74th, against a 21-year-old Chinese player ranked 60th. On the next table, India's Ankur Bhattacharjee meets Sun Yang, the Chinese defender who came through qualifying.
**Sachi Aoki v Zong Geman (9.55am UK)**: Japan's 19-year-old Aoki, ranked 64th, against China's Zong, 20, who climbed 16 places to 60th in this week's ranking.
## The qualifiers

Eight men came through qualifying on Monday and Tuesday. Borgar Haug, who [beat Chen Junsong 21-19 in a deciding game](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-qualifying-day-two-haug-chen-junsong-kang-dongsoo.html) on Tuesday, plays Japan's Ryoichi Yoshiyama, the world No 49, at 9.20am. Kang Dongsoo, the Istanbul runner-up, meets India's Manav Thakkar at 3.20pm, and Yuan Licen plays Denmark's Jonathan Groth at 8.10am.

Yuta Tanaka, who turns 26 on Wednesday, plays Romania's Iulian Chirita at 9.55am. France's Lilian Bardet and Russia's Maksim Grebnev, both beaten in the last round of qualifying on Tuesday, also have places in the main draw: Bardet plays South Korea's Park Ganghyeon and Grebnev meets Colombia's Emanuel Otalvaro.

Tang Yiren, 17, plays Germany's Andre Bertelsmeier at 2.10pm, and Romania's Eduard Ionescu, who reached the main draw after Fang Bo [withdrew injured](/news/fang-bo-withdraws-wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-injury-treatment.html), meets Australia's Finn Luu at 3.20pm.
## Singles order of play
Singles, last 64. Times are approximate and UK time.

- 7am: Mehdi Bouloussa v Csaba Andras (men)
- 8.10am: Yuan Licen v Jonathan Groth (men)
- 8.45am: Sofia-Xuan Zhang v Minhyung Jee (women); Manush Shah v Ryuusei Kawakami (men)
- 9.20am: Borgar Haug v Ryoichi Yoshiyama (men); Filippa Bergand v Ece Harac (women)
- 9.55am: Feng Yixuan v Xiaoxin Yang (women); Lilian Bardet v Park Ganghyeon (men); Sachi Aoki v Zong Geman (women); Yuta Tanaka v Iulian Chirita (men)
- 1.35pm: Ana Tofant v Andreea Dragoman (women)
- 2.10pm: Lubomir Jancarik v Alvaro Robles (men); Manika Batra v Wei Jingming (women); Andre Bertelsmeier v Tang Yiren (men); Audrey Zarif v Camille Lutz (women)
- 2.45pm: Elena Zaharia v Charlotte Lutz (women); Nicholas Lum v Navid Shams (men); Wang Xiaotong v Giorgia Piccolin (women); Ricardo Walther v Joe Seyfried (men)
- 3.20pm: Manav Thakkar v Kang Dongsoo (men); Gaia Monfardini v Tatiana Kukulkova (women); Eduard Ionescu v Finn Luu (men); Fan Shuhan v Yang Huize (women)
- 3.55pm: Sarah De Nutte v Sreeja Akula (women); Kwon Hyuk v Andrej Gacina (men); Sarvinoz Mirkadirova v Saki Shibata (women); Maksim Grebnev v Emanuel Otalvaro (men)
- 4.30pm: Marcos Freitas v Huang Youzheng (men); Maria Xiao v Sofia Polcanova (women); Ankur Bhattacharjee v Sun Yang (men); Christina Kallberg v Yoo Yerin (women)

The doubles start in the morning session, with Japan's Hashimoto and Nagasaki against China's Qin and Zong in the women's doubles at 7am, and Togami and Odo against Aditya Sareen and Minhyung Jee in the mixed doubles at 1pm.
## How to watch

WTT streams every table on its YouTube channel. Eleven's [event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html#matches) has live scores, the full draw and the order of play. The finals are on Saturday 21 November.
